message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "Greg Maxwell, who works for Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons, released a torrent on The Pirate Bay. This file holds 33 gigabytes of documents from the Royal Society that date back before 1923. In the United States, these papers are in the public domain. However, JSTOR used to sell them only. This event shows the conflict between copyright rules and access to old knowledge."}
